verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe credit notes as refund/return/adjustment records against original sales that flow into filings ('filings that reflect what you actually kept'), directly covering negative amounts through liability and reporting without manual journal fixes [kintsugi-docs-20][kintsugi-docs-34]. This is reinforced by the broader tax lifecycle (nexus, filings, registrations) and transaction sync model. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of a refund actually reducing a specific filing's liability, and detail on how partial refunds/negative amounts are represented in the API payload.
